paper.title_en: Conserved charges and the first law of black holes for field dependent symmetry generators in the covariant phase space formalism
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we generalize the covariant phase space formalism conjugate to field dependent vectors to include internal gauge transformations when gauge fields are present. In our formalism, the symmetry generators are combination of diffeomorphisms plus internal gauge transformations and depend on the field configuration. When the field dependence of the symmetry generators is considered in the covariant phase space formalism, the first law of black hole thermodynamics is a direct result for generally invariant gravitational theories. To check the validity of our formalism, we investigate the conserved charges and the first laws of thermodynamics for a torus-like black hole in Einstein-Maxwell theory and a charged Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg AdS black hole in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg nonlinear electrodynamics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在协变相空间形式中推广了场依赖对称生成元的守恒荷与黑洞第一定律，主题紧扣黑洞热力学，并通过对环面黑洞与带电 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg AdS 黑洞的算例检验其形式体系，理论深度与针对性较强，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 协变相空间形式中场依赖对称生成元的守恒荷与黑洞第一定律
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们将与场依赖矢量共轭的协变相空间形式推广到包含内禀规范变换的情形，以处理存在规范场的情形。在我们的形式体系中，对称生成元是微分同胚与内禀规范变换的组合，并依赖于场位形。当在协变相空间形式中考虑对称生成元的场依赖性时，对于一般不变的引力理论，黑洞热力学第一定律是一个直接结果。为检验我们形式体系的有效性，我们研究了 Einstein-Maxwell 理论中类环面黑洞的守恒荷与热力学第一定律，以及 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 非线性电动力学中带电 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg AdS 黑洞的守恒荷与热力学第一定律。
